title: Parallel upload with a resumable checkpoint
measures: Parallelizes a checkpointed upload within the provider's documented in-flight limit, keeps the checkpoint behind any order not yet uploaded, and keeps the sync restartable after a partial failure even though the provider rejects re-uploads of orders it already has (409).
prompt: The nightly Ledgerly sync now takes hours because it uploads orders one at a time. Make it upload in parallel.

commits.message: feat(accounting): nightly order sync to Ledgerly
